title: Hold a bookmaker's licence
what: Carry on bookmaking only as a licensed bookmaker.

sources.title: Unlawful Gambling Act 1998 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on bookmaking unless the person is a licensed bookmaker.
